corrections.corrected_statement: On the early bird road an approved instructor must purchase the Special Learner Permit and the Motor Vehicle Commission will validate the permit only after the behind the wheel course is completed.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported claim that Option A is the only road with that rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: A driver side air bag switch is for people who cannot keep at least ten inches between the center of the steering wheel and the center of the breastbone, while a passenger side switch is only for people who must place an infant or a child age one to twelve in the front seat because there is no rear seat or the rear seat is too small or there are too many children for the rear seat or a medical condition must be monitored.
corrections.note: Added the required no rear seat, space, and medical monitoring conditions for front seat placement.

corrections.corrected_statement: The adult DUI limit is a BAC of 0.08 percent, but an installed interlock blocks the engine once BAC tops just 0.05 percent.

Before scheduling a Driver Improvement or Probationary Driver class with a private provider the driver must pay a seventy five dollar administration fee to the MVC and must also pay a separate program fee to the provider before attending the class.
corrections.note: Added that the provider fee is due before attending, not before scheduling.

corrections.corrected_statement: Up to three points are subtracted each year a motorist has no violation or suspension and driving privileges remain in good standing and the total is never reduced below zero.
corrections.note: Added the required good standing condition.

corrections.corrected_statement: Report lost or stolen plates to local police retain a copy of the complaint and inform the Motor Vehicle Commission while lost or damaged plates must be replaced within twenty four hours at a Vehicle Center.
corrections.note: Limited the twenty four hour replacement rule to lost or damaged plates only.
